definitions.gloss: to cheer; to root for; to support (a team or person)
definitions.explanation: To encourage and show support for someone, typically at a sporting event or competition, by cheering, clapping, or shouting.

definitions.gloss: to support; to back up; to send reinforcements
definitions.explanation: To provide help or assistance to someone, either through encouragement or by sending additional people or resources.

notes:
One of the most common words for showing support. In everyday conversation, {応援|おうえん}する covers both cheering at events and general emotional support. The phrase ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{応援|おうえん}して⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧ is a warm, encouraging expression often used on social media or toward public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{応援|おうえん}する: to cheer for a team
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧: to rush to cheer/help
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}{団|だん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧: cheering squad, pep squad
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧{歌|か}: fight song, cheer song
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧: campaign speech (in support of a candidate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧: to support, assist — more formal; used for aid and institutional support
- ⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send cheers — specifically vocal encouragement
- ⟦{後押|あとお}し→後押し：12509_atooshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to back up, give a push — emphasizes practical help
